title: Email: Fw: You Versus the Tigers...

content.text:
From: T <timbuktom1@gmail.com>
Sent: Sunday, November 10, 2019 8:18 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: You Versus the Tigers... 
 
Today, with your piece about the Tigers versus their own AAA manager, and plenty of times before, you have provided insight and informed us Tiger fans.

But, Holy Schnizelbank! Thanks, but, can you get away with this for much longer? Does the Free Press value your sideways take on Tigers management? Will the Freep stand up against the Tigers? Do you have an escape route? Where will you go, if too much pressure?
I hope to keep reading you for the rest of my life. I love baseball. Are you going to be okay?
